div.div: مَفْجُوعٌ A man [pained, afflicted, or distressed; or] smitten by an affliction such as is termed رَزِيَّة [and فَجِيعَة, q. v.]; as also ↓ فَجِيعٌ , and [in an intensive sense] ↓ مُفَجَّعٌ . (TA.) You say, هُوَ مَفْجُوعٌ فِى مَالِهِ and أَهْلِهِ [He is pained, &c., in, or in respect of, his property, or cattle, and his family]. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
